name: gobarber-painel
description: Painel do SaaS GoBarber: cria, sobe e acompanha o ambiente de cada barbearia

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "tsx watch server/src/index.ts" "vite --config web/vite.config.ts"
scripts.build: tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
